title: QHCF historical ranking and item references
caution: Historical community material. Ranking advice and equipment statistics are not current-game claims unless separately live-verified and dated.
attribution: QHCF / DIKU-WIKI, its maintainers, page authors, and contributors. Original and archive URLs and preserved notices remain attached to each dataset.
separation_note: RangerRanking, ClassRanking, RankingList, good/evil ranking equipment, Item List, and carritems are distinct datasets. This package does not silently merge them.
location_reference_policy: Location names, including Academy mentions, are literal historical source text only. They are unresolved references and do not encode topology, access rules, mechanics, or return behavior.

datasets.title: ClassRanking
datasets.relationship: Short pointer page containing an original-post link and externally hosted class-ranking images; retained separately from text ranking guides.
datasets.body_text: Back to Main : Original post: http://www.qhcf.net/phorum/read.php?2,909898,909898#msg-909898 All Classes: http://i.imgur.com/Iguh8.png http://i.imgur.com/Xyr44.png Warriors: http://i.imgur.com/m6VhH.png http://i.imgur.com/Fqyhy.png *Technical part: To get the figures above, I sorted the class selection by "Ratio", greatest to least. If there were less than 100 PBFs for a class, I took a sample size of 10 from the middle and excluded characters created before the gank-o-meter started tracking group sizes. If there were greater than 100 PBFs, I took 10% of the total number and calculated from the middle. Totals, Averages and sample range as of 11/23/2011: Anti-Paladin (74: 32-41) Assassin (148: 67 - 81) Bard (123: 56-67) Berserker (35: 14-16, 19-21, 23, 25-27) Conjurer (55: 23-32) Druid (56: 25-34) Healer (99: 45-46, 48-50, 53-57) Invoker (104: 48-52, 54-56, 58, 60) Necro (61: 27-36) Paladin (135: 62-63, 65-73, 75, 77) Ranger (86: 39-48) Shaman (100: 46-54, 56) Shifter (147: 67-71, 73-79, 81-83) Thief (144: 66-79) Transmuter (84: 38-46, 48) Warrior (647: 291-355) To get a 1-10 scale, I took the range of a given category (lowest number and greatest number), the average of all the numbers in the category, plotted points at 1, 5, and 10, and then calculated a quadratic regression curve through the points. So, the best for any category is 10.0 and the worst is 1.0, with the average of the numbers being equal to 5. The formulae for each is below. Formulas for Classes: pk/hr = (-7.309*(x^2)) + 29.7659x + 0.2193 pk Win = (-0.0002552115*(x^2)) + 0.1394929873x + 0.2678560592 pk Loss = (0.00655*(x^2)) - 0.64924x + 16.74914 avg kill group size (solo) = (11.8187*(x^2)) - 55.6521x + 66.4775 avg kill group size (support) = (-6.43076*(x^2)) + 34.69306x -36.2598 avg death group size = (55.8171987*(x^2)) - 193.0751788x + 167.603349 mob deaths = (0.017361*(x^2)) - 1.185173x + 18.996944 hours = (0.0001249*(x^2)) - 0.0031453x -1.1426302 Popularity = (-0.0000522*(x^2)) + 0.0502771x -0.6958059 Back to Main :
